cohort: 380 neonates admitted to the neonatal unit of Leratong Hospital, Johannesburg, South Africa, between April 2013 and July 2013.
finding: The neonatal mortality rate at Leratong Hospital was lower than rates found in other studies, with preterm birth, low birth weight, and birth by caesarean section being the strongest predictors of death.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of admitted neonates was 1824.5 (29) g.
